name: no.nordicsemi.android.support.v18.scanner.ScannerService
description: On Android 4.3 through 7.x, Nordic Semiconductor BLE Scanner Compat uses this Service to run background Bluetooth LE scans. It starts or stops scans and passes nearby-device results to the app.
disableEffect: Background Bluetooth LE scans on those Android versions will stop, which can break app features that rely on nearby-device discovery.
